boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.
identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not consciousness, personhood, continuity, employment, or authority evidence.

methods.candidate_workaround: Keep the fast-forward-only Sable canonical branch authoritative, run scoped recent-round and v644-v7 checks there, then use exactly one fresh clean named Sable validation branch and D-first worktree at the exact final head without pushing it.
methods.failure_signature: Inherited final validation exposed a PowerShell parser fault while the current phase forbids detached validation and reserves the full repository suite to Eiren.
methods.recurrence_guard: Forbid detached validation, full-suite ownership by this seat, a second additional replay, any validation-lane push, and any promotion of a failed parser command.
methods.rollback: Stop the named replay, retain its failed receipt, and return to the clean canonical Sable branch without deleting, resetting, rewriting, or mutating another lane.
methods.scope_boundary: Candidate workflow until the one authorized exact-final named-lane replay passes; never exhaustive validation, independent reproduction, or scientific evidence.
methods.title: Canonical scoped validation with one clean named-lane replay
trigger_preconditions: non-Eiren phase under the current scoped validation rule
one additional bounded same-owner named-lane replay

methods.candidate_workaround: Read every mandatory skill and directly required reference completely in its own bounded command before task actions, then run discovery separately.
methods.failure_signature: A combined mandatory-skill and discovery read timed out before returning a complete receipt.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer a complete instruction read from a timed-out batch; preserve the timeout and obtain one end-to-end witness per mandatory file.
methods.rollback: Discard only the incomplete batch result, retain its negative, and reread each authoritative instruction source directly.
methods.scope_boundary: Instruction-read reliability only; not authority, identity continuity, or validation evidence.
methods.title: Standalone complete reads for mandatory skills and references

methods.candidate_workaround: Treat exit 1 as a no-match result, inspect the current exact-head task group in the registry, and read only the newest directly relevant same-day note.
methods.failure_signature: An exact phase-keyword memory search returned no match although current context existed under broader indexing and an ad-hoc note.
methods.recurrence_guard: A no-match query cannot establish absence; use the newest indexed task group and bounded ad-hoc note before stopping.
methods.rollback: Retain the no-match receipt and avoid broad rollout scans unless the bounded fallback remains insufficient.
methods.scope_boundary: Memory retrieval ergonomics only; memory claims remain subordinate to live repository verification.
methods.title: Newest-task-group and same-day-note memory fallback

methods.candidate_workaround: Run fetch, local anchor ancestry, live-remote equality, owner ancestry, and named-lane cleanliness as separate exact witnesses with measured envelopes.
methods.failure_signature: A parallel three-lane source and owner audit exceeded the parent runner window and returned no usable combined receipt.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not combine network and large-status operations under a shorter parent ceiling; record exact hashes from each completed witness.
methods.rollback: Retain the timed-out batch, make no mutation from it, and require all standalone witnesses before fast-forward.
methods.scope_boundary: Repository continuity verification only; not scientific or independent-reproduction evidence.
methods.title: Separated network, ancestry, equality, and cleanliness witnesses

methods.candidate_workaround: Map exit 1 to an explicit NO_MATCH witness, keep other nonzero codes as faults, and audit the exact 29 proposal files covering all 290 frozen proposals.
methods.failure_signature: A valid ripgrep exit 1 stopped a batched novelty probe before later patterns ran.
methods.recurrence_guard: State no-match semantics explicitly and never let one expected absence suppress later collision categories.
methods.rollback: Retain the interrupted batch and rerun the full bounded category set before freezing any proposal.
methods.scope_boundary: Search control-flow reliability only; human semantic review remains required.
methods.title: Explicit no-match normalization for semantic novelty probes
trigger_preconditions: absence is an expected semantic result

methods.candidate_workaround: Stop at the privilege refusal, query only executable and command presence without elevation, and record Sandbox unavailable rather than enabling a feature or rebooting.
methods.failure_signature: The optional-feature status query required elevation on the host.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never elevate or change Windows features for an availability audit; a privilege refusal is a bounded negative, not a retry invitation.
methods.rollback: Make no host change, retain the refusal, and use the canonical and named repository lanes for bounded tests.
methods.scope_boundary: Host capability observation only; not sandbox execution or security assurance.
methods.title: Non-elevating Windows Sandbox availability audit

methods.candidate_workaround: Use an ordered array of explicit replacement pairs with case-sensitive String.Replace, require destination absence before creation, then inspect exact diffs for semantic leftovers.
methods.failure_signature: PowerShell rejected a case-insensitive replacement dictionary containing V6446 and v6446 as duplicate keys.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never use a case-insensitive map when replacement keys differ only by case; separate mechanical copies from semantic apply-patch review.
methods.rollback: If parsing or inspection fails, retain the negative, remove no history, and do not promote the generated file until exact diff review passes.
methods.scope_boundary: Versioned compatibility scaffolding only; semantic correctness still requires explicit review and tests.
methods.title: Case-sensitive ordered-pair compatibility rewrite

methods.candidate_workaround: Use git status --porcelain -uall before staging, direct expected-path existence checks, and git diff --cached --name-only after staging.
methods.failure_signature: Default porcelain output collapsed a new phase directory and produced a false missing-file report.
methods.recurrence_guard: An exact file-set receipt must enumerate leaf paths, not a collapsed directory placeholder.
methods.rollback: Retain the inaccurate comparison, make no commit from it, and rerun against uncollapsed or staged leaf paths.
methods.scope_boundary: Git file-set enumeration only; content, privacy, and semantic validation remain separate.
methods.title: Uncollapsed untracked and staged exact-file comparison

methods.candidate_workaround: Split existence, status, and content inspection into bounded per-file calls and promote only complete outputs.
methods.failure_signature: A combined status, existence, and diff-stat probe exceeded its command window after returning only partial decisive output.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not append an unbounded diff-stat walk to the first file-existence witness on a large packet.
methods.rollback: Retain the timeout, ignore incomplete aggregate output except its explicit file-existence rows, and rerun bounded checks.
methods.scope_boundary: Operational inspection only; it does not validate artifact semantics, privacy, or final integrity.
methods.title: Bounded per-file inspection after combined status timeout

methods.candidate_workaround: Enumerate exact leaf filenames first and read only a returned path.
methods.failure_signature: A read assumed nested record and witness directories even though the phase stored Method Flow leaf files directly under its method-flow directory.
methods.recurrence_guard: Treat phase Method Flow storage layout as discoverable state, not an inherited directory convention.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed path assumption and rerun the read against an enumerated leaf path.
methods.scope_boundary: Filesystem path discovery only; it does not validate Method Flow content.
methods.title: Enumerate Method Flow leaf paths before exact reads

methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect the known predecessor validator, phase lifecycle receipts, and exact current files directly before expanding search scope.
methods.failure_signature: A broad recursive search across scripts and tests exceeded the bounded command window without returning evidence.
methods.recurrence_guard: Start from explicit phase-relative surfaces when the sought lifecycle schema is already localized.
methods.rollback: Retain the timeout and narrow the read-only search; expand only if the known surfaces are insufficient.
methods.scope_boundary: Search strategy only; it does not validate lifecycle receipt truth.
methods.title: Known-surface search instead of broad helper scan

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the exact source as UTF-8 and apply small semantic regions with independently verified context.
methods.failure_signature: Large or console-rendered patch contexts were rejected atomically when copied UTF-8 text did not match exactly.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never derive culturally specific patch text from mojibake console output; verify UTF-8 source and keep patch regions bounded.
methods.rollback: A rejected patch changes no file; retain the negative and reapply only after exact source inspection.
methods.scope_boundary: Patch transport and encoding only; wording remains subject to Māori authority and substantive review.
methods.title: Small UTF-8-exact semantic patch regions

methods.candidate_workaround: Set UTF-8 output encoding for the single runner process, rerun summarize, and parse the emitted JSON receipt.
methods.failure_signature: The Method Flow summary print could not encode valid Māori text through a legacy Windows console code page.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use process-local UTF-8 when Unicode may reach stdout; never replace or anglicize Māori wording to satisfy a console codec.
methods.rollback: Retain the failed print, leave host settings unchanged, and rerun only the bounded command with UTF-8 output.
methods.scope_boundary: Console transport only; it does not confer cultural authority or validate substantive wording.
methods.title: Process-local UTF-8 for Unicode Method Flow output

methods.candidate_workaround: Convert the returned exact leaf listing into an allowlist and read only paths present in it.
methods.failure_signature: A composite follow-up read guessed a filename that the immediately preceding exact leaf listing did not contain.
methods.recurrence_guard: Stop before a follow-up read when its leaf is absent from the enumerated allowlist.
methods.rollback: Retain the missing-file negative and rerun only the allowlisted exact reads.
methods.scope_boundary: Filesystem read selection only; it does not validate artifact content or currency.
methods.title: Enumerated leaf list as a follow-up read allowlist

witnesses.boundary: This validates command shaping for required reads, not the scientific or authority content of the phase.
witnesses.expected: Every required file is read through its end without sharing the failed combined envelope.
witnesses.observed: All four mandatory files completed as standalone reads before repository mutation.
witnesses.procedure: Read the family index, routing reference, Method Flow skill, and Method Flow schema as separate complete operations.

witnesses.boundary: This is memory retrieval evidence, not live Git truth or repository authority.
witnesses.expected: Relevant v644-v6 source, validation refinement, negative baseline, and Method Flow context are recovered without a broad rollout scan.
witnesses.observed: The task group and same-day note supplied the exact source chain, 1,584 baseline, named-lane rule, and Method Flow continuation.
witnesses.procedure: After the exact-keyword no-match, inspect the current exact-head task group and the newest relevant same-day ad-hoc note.

witnesses.boundary: This establishes safe Git continuity, not scientific correctness or owner independence.
witnesses.expected: Ilyra final is four-way equal with all anchors ancestral and zero merges; Sable is clean, remote-equal, and a strict ancestor.
witnesses.observed: All exact checks passed; Sable was 127 commits behind with zero commits outside the Ilyra final and advanced later by fast-forward only.
witnesses.procedure: Fetch once, verify Ilyra local/upstream/tracking/live equality and all anchors, verify the named validation lane clean, then verify Sable clean equality and ancestry separately.
witnesses.scope: Same-owner and inherited-owner repository continuity checks.

witnesses.boundary: This supports bounded semantic novelty review; it is not a proof that no conceivable paraphrase overlaps.
witnesses.expected: Every category completes, no-match states are preserved, and collision candidates are removed before x1.
witnesses.observed: The complete audit exposed collisions in constraint algebra, non-inferiority, citation entailment, key rotation, and reparse points; the final ten use distinct mechanisms.
witnesses.procedure: Enumerate the 29 x1 proposal files, run each candidate-title category with explicit no-match handling, and reject semantically colliding candidates.
witnesses.scope: All 290 frozen proposal titles plus mechanism-level manual review.

witnesses.boundary: This validates the non-elevating audit method, not Windows Sandbox availability or security.
witnesses.expected: The audit completes without host change and yields an explicit available or unavailable state.
witnesses.observed: The executable path and command were absent; no elevation, feature change, security weakening, or reboot occurred.
witnesses.procedure: After the feature-status privilege refusal, query WindowsSandbox.exe path and command presence without elevation.

witnesses.boundary: This validates one mechanical rewrite workflow, not the later evidence implementation.
witnesses.expected: Files are created once, preserve family-current naming, and expose no unresolved v644-v6 or Ilyra semantic role in current-phase fields.
witnesses.observed: The ordered-pair copy completed; exact inspection found and corrected source phase, counts, focus, lane owner, route order, and successor assertions.
witnesses.procedure: Create v644-v7 builder and test compatibility copies with ordered case-sensitive pairs, then grep and patch phase-specific semantic leftovers.
witnesses.scope: Two new v644-v7 scaffold files only.

witnesses.boundary: This validates leaf enumeration, not file content or final commit integrity.
witnesses.expected: All 46 expected leaf paths exist and no unlisted x2 file is included.
witnesses.observed: The corrected leaf enumeration exposed the real phase files instead of one collapsed directory; staged parity is required before promotion.
witnesses.procedure: Enumerate untracked leaf files with git status --porcelain -uall and compare them to the frozen expected list, then repeat from the staged index before commit.

witnesses.boundary: This validates the bounded inspection method, not the files it inspected.
witnesses.expected: All four files are identified and stale copied markers are enumerated without repository mutation.
witnesses.observed: All four files were confirmed and the bounded marker search completed with an explicit stale-field list.
witnesses.procedure: Inspect each x2 file existence and size, then search only the named files for stale phase markers.
witnesses.scope: Four Sable v644-v7 x2 source and test files.

witnesses.boundary: The witness validates path discovery only.
witnesses.expected: Both exact leaf files are read completely.
witnesses.observed: The enumerated record and witness files were read successfully without mutation.
witnesses.procedure: List the method-flow directory and read the exact returned v6447-m08 record and witness filenames.
witnesses.scope: Current Sable v644-v7 Method Flow directory.

witnesses.boundary: This validates narrowing efficiency, not lifecycle completeness.
witnesses.expected: Required lifecycle surfaces are identified without another broad scan.
witnesses.observed: The predecessor validation directory and current validator supplied the required receipt and lifecycle structure.
witnesses.procedure: Read the exact inherited v644-v6 lifecycle file list and current v644-v7 validator rather than recursively scanning unrelated helpers.
witnesses.scope: Named predecessor lifecycle artifacts and current validator.

witnesses.expected: Each bounded patch applies atomically and preserves valid Unicode.
witnesses.observed: The smaller exact-context patches applied successfully and retained the valid Māori spelling.

witnesses.scope: Sable v644-v7 evidence builder wording and bounded count fields.

witnesses.observed: The summary completed, preserved Māori text, and parsed with twelve methods and eleven witnesses before M13 was appended.

witnesses.scope: Current Sable v644-v7 Method Flow ledger.
